$ send-mail compose --to a@example.com --subject x --body hi --format rtf
exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
send-mail: error: --format must be one of "markdown","text","html" but got "rtf"
Usage: send-mail compose --to=ADDRESS,... --subject=SUBJECT (--body=BODY | --body-file=FILE) [flags]
Run "send-mail compose --help" for details.
